name: MKT_CAMP_ROLLUPS
description: The MKT_CAMP_ROLLUPS table stores Rollup Metrics data.

columns.name: CAMPAIGN_ID
columns.description: An identifier for the Campaign used as a foreign key to the MKT_CAMPAIGNS table.

columns.name: NUM_OF_LEADS
columns.description: Count of leads that are associated to the campaign.

columns.name: NUM_OF_OPEN_LEADS
columns.description: Count of open leads that are associated to the campaign.

columns.name: NUM_OF_CONVERTED_LEADS
columns.description: Count of converted leads that are associated to the campaign.

columns.name: NUM_OF_OPEN_HOT_LEADS
columns.description: Count of open hot leads that are associated to the campaign.

columns.name: OPEN_LEAD_DEAL_AMT
columns.description: Sum of the potential revenues from qualified and unqualified open leads associated to the campaign.

columns.name: NUM_OF_OPTY
columns.description: Count of opportunities that are associated to the campaign.

columns.name: NUM_OF_OPEN_OPTY
columns.description: Count of open opportunities that are associated to the campaign.

columns.name: NUM_OF_WON_OPTY
columns.description: Count of won opportunities that are associated to the campaign.

columns.name: OPEN_OPTY_REVN_AMT
columns.description: The cumulative total of open opportunity potential revenue amount associated to the campaign.

columns.name: WON_OPTY_REVN_AMT
columns.description: The cumulative total of won opportunity potential revenue amount associated to the campaign.

columns.name: ALL_OPTY_REVN_AMT
columns.description: The cumulative total of all opportunity potential revenue amount associated to the campaign.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code for extensibility.

columns.name: CORP_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Corporate currency code for extensibility.

columns.name: CURCY_CONV_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Currency conversion rate type for extensibility.

columns.name: NUM_OF_EMAIL_OPENS
columns.description: Count of email opens associated to the campaign.

columns.name: NUM_OF_EMAIL_SENDS
columns.description: Count of email sends associated to the campaign.

columns.name: NUM_OF_EMAIL_CLICKTHROUGHS
columns.description: Count of email clickthroughs associated to the campaign.

columns.name: NUM_OF_EMAILS
columns.description: Count of email activities associated to the campaign.

columns.name: NUM_OF_WEB_VISITS
columns.description: Count of web visits associated to the campaign.

columns.name: NUM_OF_CONTACTS
columns.description: Count of targeted contacts associated to the campaign.

columns.name: NUM_OF_FORM_SUBMITS
columns.description: Count of form submits associated to the campaign.

columns.name: NUM_OF_RETIRED_LEADS
columns.description: Count of retired leads that are associated to the campaign.

columns.name: NUM_OF_NOSALE_OPTY
columns.description: Count of no sale opportunities that are associated to the campaign.

columns.name: NUM_OF_LOST_OPTY
columns.description: Count of lost opportunities that are associated to the campaign.

columns.name: NUM_OF_ENGAGED_CONTACTS
columns.description: Count of engaged contacts associated to the campaign.

columns.name: CONVERTED_OPTY_REVN_AMT
columns.description: The cumulative total of converted opportunity potential revenue amount associated to the campaign.
